description: A product family (VM Plans, AI Tokens, SaaS Storage, Remote Storage). Behavioral and self-describing: it declares the resource types a member plan may include, its sub-category axis, and which configurator builder authors it. Adding a family is a new document, not a schema change (ADR 0007).

fields.label: Configurator Builder
fields.description: Which Configurator builder authors this category (VM Rungs or Simple).

fields.label: Provision Target
fields.description: What a member plan provisions: Server, Resource (per-unit), or blank (not directly provisionable).

fields.label: Sub-Category Label
fields.description: What a sub-category means for this family; blank = no sub-category axis.

fields.label: Billing Type
fields.description: Fixed = flat rate per cycle (bundle); Metered = per-unit usage billing (ADR 0008).

fields.label: Billing Interval
fields.description: The metering cadence for a Metered family. Leave blank for Fixed families.

fields.label: Pricing Mode
fields.description: Metered families only: Grandfathered locks the provision rate, Live reads the current Catalog Rate each period (ADR 0002).

fields.label: Settlement Mode
fields.description: What happens when the allowance runs out: Postpaid Overage (bill the excess) or Prepaid Pack (drawn-down balance) (ADR 0015).

fields.label: Reporting Mode
fields.description: How a consumer service reports usage: Authoritative (running total) or Incremental (accumulated deltas) (ADR 0015).

fields.label: Allowed Resource Types
fields.description: A member plan's composition may only use these resource types. Blank = unconstrained.

name: Plan Category
